registered_before: constructing the 384 reserved input cases, labels, model inference or score inspection

data.rule_allocation: ROC-04A deterministic 8!-8 shuffled index 768:1152, one source example for each unseen table, source identity fixed
data.source_encoder: identical 79-feature ROC-02 encoder, original ROC-04A B/C distractor rules and delay 2..16
data.generator: research_gym.analysis.roc04_permutation_source.source_schedules(...) plus make_case(...) using returned reserved pool only
data.active_table_identity: each distinct held-out rule appears exactly once
data.oracle: symbolic_execute and literal table row lookup both verify every label
data.new_source_lock: generate, hash, and freeze all 384 labeled cases in a one-shot post-lock test; permit only confirmatory readout and declared diagnostics
data.original_sealed_policy: NEVER read original ROC02 family6/7 example files or generate their inputs or score their labels
data.model_scope: use exactly 12 hash-verified ROC04A frozen step1920 checkpoint files; optimizer state remains loaded only for identity verification, no updates

primary.endpoint: per-seed held-out test answer-accuracy high_permutation512 minus low_affine4, same 384 reserved cases
primary.acceptance: at least 5/6 seeds improve; unweighted mean accuracy difference ≥0.20; exact one-sided 64-sign-flip p ≤ 0.05
primary.one_sided_p: (number of sign-flip six-seed mean differences ≥ observed mean, inclusive ties)/64
primary.analysis_unit: independent model initialization seed; 384 shared heldout cases are within-seed paired, and table identity count does not multiply independent model count
primary.locked_rule: all six seeds and both arms are included; cannot choose checkpoint, optimizer, rank, penalty, test source, or model subset after test

separate_competence_gate.table_exact: ≥50% complete eight-row table reconstruction in ≥5/6 high-diversity seeds
separate_competence_gate.report: independent PASS/FAIL; preserve original ROC04A development results

secondary.legal_early_table_edit: for each test record, swap A rule table output values at queried q and (q+4)%8; exact symbolic answer must change; measure altered-target accuracy and paired original/swap correctness
secondary.label_preserving_distractor_edit: for each eligible test record, change first B/C distractor rule to a different previously exposed original train rule; true A answer must be unchanged; report prediction invariance and correctness
additional_metrics: permutation rule ID and query stratification
raw model checkpoint SHA and source SHA
secondary.scope: one-shot independent rule-table holdout test from frozen ROC04A model and registered ROC04B source; no additional model optimization or ROC01 causal mechanism label claimed

stop_conditions: reserved table overlaps train/dev or prior eight original affine rules
wrong test count or post-lock model refit
original ROC02 family6/7 source input access
